subject.title: [Feature]: Smart default utility model derived from the primary provider

question: Should an unset `utilityModel` automatically use the primary provider’s declared small model, with `""` permanently meaning utility routing is disabled?
rationale: This changes established default cost and model-routing behavior and gives an existing config field a new sentinel state; source inspection cannot determine the intended product contract.

options.title: Approve provider defaults
options.body: Adopt provider-declared automatic routing through one shared resolver, with consistent empty-string disabling and upgrade proof.

options.title: Retain explicit opt-in
options.body: Preserve current behavior so utility narration and cheaper internal calls activate only after users configure a model.

recommendation.title: Approve provider defaults
recommendation.body: Adopt provider-declared automatic routing through one shared resolver, with consistent empty-string disabling and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current utility-model and narrated-progress behavior appears to originate from their recent merged work, and the issue carries a protected maintainer decision signal.
